run_tokenize_indic_text: run the script to tokenize Indic text by piping text and passing a language code as an argument
run_normalize_indic_script: run the script to normalize Indic script text using IndicNormalizerFactory with nuktas preserved and nasals untouched
run_trivial_tokenize_indic: run the script to apply trivial_tokenize on normalized Indic text for a specified language
review_indic_normalizer_factory: review the IndicNormalizerFactory usage to create a normalizer with remove_nuktas false and nasals_mode do_nothing
summarize_tokenization_pipeline: summarize the stdin to stdout tokenization pipeline that normalizes then tokenizes Indic language text line by line
